methods.levelReason: The opposite y-coefficients permit immediate addition elimination using elementary linear-system algebra.

methods.label: Substitute y from the first equation
methods.explanation:
The first equation gives \(y=5-x\). Substituting this into the second equation leaves only \(x\):
\[
x-(5-x)=1,\qquad 2x=6.
\]
Thus \(x=3\), and then \(y=5-3=2\). The intersection is \((3,2)\), so its \(x\)-coordinate is \(3\).
methods.levelReason: Substitution and removing parentheses are elementary procedures at the same prerequisite level as addition elimination.
